cause: TypeScript syntax error: Promise<readonly IndexEntry>> has an extra closing >.
affectedComponents: Backend build, workspace indexing, search, desktop/CLI/mobile/vscode workspace features
riskLevel: Platform cannot compile; deployments blocked.
requiredFix: Fix signature to Promise<readonly IndexEntry[]> or readonly array syntax, add focused indexer compile test.
dependencies: None; blocks all backend build/test pipelines.
suggestedImplementation: Patch type, run root typecheck/build.

cause: Fourteen implemented route modules are not mounted in the API composition root.
affectedComponents: Tools, workspace engine, orchestrator, extensions, marketplace, knowledge, runtime, simulation, billing analytics, cluster/distributed APIs
riskLevel: Existing clients call endpoints that resolve to 404; services appear complete but are unreachable.
requiredFix: Mount routers and construct their dependencies in ServiceProvider/composition root, or remove client calls until supported.
dependencies: ToolRegistry, DynamicModelRegistry, FileService, WorkspaceIndexer, SnapshotService, orchestrator services.
suggestedImplementation: Add dependency providers and route registrations with auth policy tests.

cause: Client API paths use /tools, /workspace, /billing-analytics, /orchestrator, /extensions while backend mounts only /models, /billing, /workspaces, etc.
affectedComponents: Dashboard, desktop, CLI, mobile, VS Code extension
riskLevel: Large portions of UI/CLI/extension fail despite present screens and methods.
requiredFix: Generate an OpenAPI contract from mounted routes and make all clients consume one shared typed SDK.
suggestedImplementation: Introduce contract tests comparing client endpoint inventory to server router inventory.

cause: Mounted conversation router lacks /:id/send and /:id/send/stream, while every client calls them.
affectedComponents: Chat streaming, dashboard chat, desktop chat, CLI chat, mobile chat, VS Code chat
riskLevel: Core chat UX fails or falls back to non-existent endpoints.
requiredFix: Mount conversation-engine router or add send/stream handlers to mounted conversation router.
suggestedImplementation: Route streaming through existing conversation engine; add SSE contract tests.

cause: ServiceProvider wires CRUD services only; workspace engine, tool registry, dynamic model registry, orchestrator and marketplace runtime dependencies are absent.
affectedComponents: Backend dependency injection, tools, workspace files, marketplace, agents
riskLevel: Implemented services cannot be called safely because required instances are never created.
requiredFix: Extend composition root with all existing engines and pass to mounted routers without duplicating business logic.
suggestedImplementation: Add provider factories and health checks for each subsystem.

cause: Backend test suite has failing tests and eventually OOMs under normal vitest run.
riskLevel: No reliable regression signal; memory leak or test isolation issue possible.
requiredFix: Fix failing assertions, isolate heavy tests, configure Vitest memory limits/workers.
suggestedImplementation: Run failing files individually; add heap profiling for long suite.

cause: Dashboard typecheck fails due query key type mismatch and missing @testing-library/react dependency.
riskLevel: Dashboard cannot be treated as production-ready; test files cannot compile.
requiredFix: Fix hook generic types/query keys; add missing testing dependency.
suggestedImplementation: Run npx tsc and vitest in dashboard CI.

cause: CLI imports @inquirer/prompts but package is undeclared; API method getToolStats missing; nullable conversationId passed to string APIs.
riskLevel: CLI does not typecheck and interactive commands may crash.
requiredFix: Declare dependency, align API surface, narrow nullable IDs before calls.
dependencies: CLI package manifest and api service.
suggestedImplementation: Add CLI typecheck to CI.

cause: VS Code extension typecheck fails in command and provider code.
affectedComponents: VS Code extension activation, editor commands, completions, utility commands
riskLevel: Extension package cannot be built reliably; marketplace publication blocked.
requiredFix: Fix async openTextDocument handling, QuickPick item typing, InlineCompletionTriggerKind enum usage.
suggestedImplementation: Add extension typecheck/build tests.

cause: Mobile dependency graph conflicts React 19 with React Native 0.76 peer React 18 and misses expo-status-bar.
riskLevel: Install/typecheck fail without legacy peer deps; runtime compatibility risk.
requiredFix: Align Expo/RN/React versions and add missing package.
suggestedImplementation: Run expo doctor and typecheck in CI.

cause: Dashboard production build fetches Google Font at build time; sandbox build failed due network.
riskLevel: Offline/air-gapped deployments fail.
requiredFix: Use local font asset or pre-bundled font; set outputFileTracingRoot.
suggestedImplementation: Replace next/font/google with next/font/local.

cause: Dependency audits report critical/high vulnerabilities in every package area.
affectedComponents: Supply chain, desktop packaging, mobile, backend
riskLevel: Known vulnerable transitive dependencies ship to users.
requiredFix: Triage npm audit findings, upgrade or replace vulnerable packages, document exceptions.
suggestedImplementation: Create security dependency dashboard and weekly audit job.

cause: Explorer rename/copy/move/delete call tool IDs such as workspace.rename but no mounted /tools router or verified tool definitions.
riskLevel: Explorer operations are UI-connected but backend-unverified.
requiredFix: Reuse existing workspace file API or register/mount file tools with contract tests.
suggestedImplementation: Add file operation integration tests through preload IPC.

cause: Monaco completion provider inserts TODO snippet and is not connected to provider/orchestrator completion APIs.
riskLevel: Editor appears AI-capable but suggestions are local placeholder snippets.
requiredFix: Route completions through existing provider/orchestrator endpoint when available; remove TODO placeholder.
suggestedImplementation: Add cancellation/debounce and telemetry around completions.

cause: Desktop chat hardcodes conversation id current and does not create/select conversations from backend.
riskLevel: Messages may be sent to a non-existent conversation.
requiredFix: Reuse conversation create/list APIs and activeConversationId store before stream.
suggestedImplementation: Add chat panel integration test.

cause: Authentication schemes differ: dashboard/mobile use Bearer Firebase token; desktop/CLI/VS Code use X-API-Key; backend auth middleware likely expects verified auth context.
riskLevel: Clients may be unauthorized even with configured credentials.
requiredFix: Document supported auth modes and update middleware/clients consistently.
suggestedImplementation: Add auth matrix tests for all client types.

cause: Queue/worker modules exist but app startup only connects Redis and HTTP server; schedulers/workers are not initialized.
riskLevel: Asynchronous workflows and retries may never run.
requiredFix: Create explicit worker process entrypoints and deployment manifests; register queues with health checks.
suggestedImplementation: Add worker smoke test and process supervision docs.

cause: Event bus is in-memory; distributed-event modules exist but are not wired into app composition.
riskLevel: Events do not cross process boundaries; subscribers in unstarted workers miss events.
requiredFix: Bridge local EventBus to distributed bus/queue when cluster mode is enabled.
suggestedImplementation: Add publisher/subscriber inventory tests.

cause: Electron security policy exists but audit did not find enforced CSP/window navigation/openExternal allowlist validation in IPC layer.
riskLevel: Potential unsafe external URL opening and renderer trust boundary gaps.
requiredFix: Apply security policies in BrowserWindow config and validate openExternal URLs.
suggestedImplementation: Add IPC security tests.

cause: Billing service contains production placeholders and clients call billing-analytics routes that are unmounted.
riskLevel: Billing appears present but is not production integrated with payment provider.
requiredFix: Wire PaymentService and billing analytics routes or hide billing UI until live.
suggestedImplementation: Add billing provider sandbox integration tests.

cause: Push notification permission/token registration contains In production comments and no backend registration verification.
riskLevel: Notifications UI/hooks may not deliver push messages.
requiredFix: Implement Expo notification token registration endpoint and client flow.
suggestedImplementation: Add device-token API tests.

cause: Several browser/MCP/security modules contain production placeholder comments for Playwright/MCP/GeoIP/seed data.
riskLevel: Feature completeness is overstated in production contexts.
requiredFix: Replace placeholders with real adapters or feature-flag unavailable capabilities.
suggestedImplementation: Add unavailable-state tests.

cause: Desktop build passes typecheck/vite but electron-builder was not validated after native modules were installed with --ignore-scripts earlier; native better-sqlite3/node-pty packaging risk remains.
riskLevel: Packaged app may fail on native module load.
requiredFix: Run full electron-builder in CI with native rebuild and platform matrix.
suggestedImplementation: Add release smoke launch tests.

cause: No monorepo-level workspace package manager configuration; package-lock files exist at root and desktop, sub-app installs are independent.
riskLevel: Version skew and duplicate React/TypeScript dependencies across apps.
requiredFix: Adopt npm workspaces/pnpm workspace and lockfile policy.
suggestedImplementation: Create workspace root package manager config.

cause: Heavy mocks cover Firebase/Redis globally; integration tests do not verify real provider connectivity.
riskLevel: Green unit tests can hide broken environment/config/dependency injection.
requiredFix: Add opt-in integration suite with local Redis/Firebase emulator and contract tests.
suggestedImplementation: Mark integration tests separately and run nightly.
